text.tspan: An HTTP Conditional Write Refused as Stale
PATCH /api/v1/tasks/{id} with an If-Match that no longer matches: the loopback gates pass, the precondition is present, but the store compares revisions under its lock and the adapter answers
412 with the current resource and a fresh ETag.
enforceOrigin: a browser Origin on a mutating
method must name this server, else 403
dispatch: task path matches, id must be 8 hex
unknown fields refused, at least one change
Read(): a checked read for validation
again; every read builds a fresh store)
withLock LOCK_EX; strict preflight check; re-read
lifecycle only when the change touches them
Mismatch: another writer changed this task since
Read(): current task and its revision
The client can decide again without a second round trip. A
matching If-Match would instead have produced 200 with
the updated resource and its new ETag.
